class.name: PathExtrudeProfileCircle
class.brief_description: A resource to define circular extrusion profiles for [PathExtrude3D] nodes.
class.description: This resource defines a full or partial circular profile for [PathExtrude3D]. The profile can optionally close an angular gap and generate either a spherical or arrow-shaped end cap.

members.member: If true, any circle defined with less than [code]TAU[/code] sweep will have an extra flat face to close the mesh.
The distance along +Z from the base to the arrow flare ring.
The additional radius of the arrow flare ring beyond [member radius].
The additional distance along +Z from the flare ring to the arrow tip ring.
The radius of the arrow tip ring. Set to zero to create a pointed tip.
The height of the spherical end cap along +Z.
Selects a spherical cap or an arrow cap.
The number of latitude segments in spherical mode.
The angle at which the profile sweep ends. Angles are measured in radians.
The distance from the center to the edges of the swept circle.
The number of radial segments used to construct the circle and arrow end caps.
If true, the normals of the circle will be smoothed.
The angle at which the profile sweep begins. Angles are measured in radians.
